1445-3899-4871-6277.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-3899-4871-6277.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

225-2645-3430-3664.easyPrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant doesn't have summoning sickness.
225-2645-3430-3664.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

978-6797--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with persist
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1981-2034-2415-6273.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

2749-4591-8089.description:
Activate Wall of Blood by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

728-1981-2415-2741.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
728-1981-2415-2741.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1308-4772-4826-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

372-997-4783.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Abdel Adrian, scrying 1.
Choose to have Abdel Adrian returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
Hellkite Courser returns to the battlefield from exile, triggering itself, putting Abdel Adrain from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Hellkite Courser and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each exiled permanent.
Repeat.

1394-2060-2921-7038-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
1394-2060-2921-7038-7803.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Brad Boimler.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Brad Boimler.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-997-7730.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4302-5256-5929.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4302-5256-5929.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Leyline of Transformation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

3750-7283-7651.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five Treasures.
Raphael is indestructible.
An opponent cannot block and kill Smaug.
3750-7283-7651.description:
Declare Smaug as an attacker, triggering its ability, dealing at least 5 damage to Raphael.
Raphael triggers, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat
3750-7283-7651.notes: If you control more Treasures, you'll net additional {R} each loop, which won't be lost due to Raphael's effect. You can then redirect Smaug's damage to any desired target(s).

2060-4770-6930-7646.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1451-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Pyreheart Wolf
When Pyreheart Wolf dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Pyreheart Wolf
When Pyreheart Wolf dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Pyreheart Wolf enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
1451-6797-6972.notes: If Pyreheart Wolf starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

671-5641-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-5641-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

341-457-1458-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
341-457-1458-4404.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Umori.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1116-6797-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
1116-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Sek'Kuar and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4460-4689.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4460-4689.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Otharri as attackers.
Otharri triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

632-2034-3621-4742-5129.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-2034-3621-4742-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

1912-4131-7280.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
1912-4131-7280.description:
Cause Basalt Monolith to become a creature using Donatello.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

4772-5525-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4772-5525-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Llanowar Loamspeaker
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

104-3330-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3330-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2044-2292-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Peema Outrider.
When Peema Outrider dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Peema Outrider enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

147-413-3440.description:
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Demonic Gifts, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Demonic Gifts.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Demonic Gifts triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities from step 5.

1818-5010-6797-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-5010-6797-6900.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

856-2034-5220-6900.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
856-2034-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
856-2034-5220-6900.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2792-3277-3647.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
2792-3277-3647.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Izzet Chronarch and Great Whale
When Izzet Chronarch and Great Whale enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
2792-3277-3647.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Great Whale.

339-677-4359-5147.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2086-2919-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2558-5226-5727-6705.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Frog creature token.
When the Frog enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4359-6642.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4359-6642.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4359-6642.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

224-280-1772-2653.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Nissa trigger
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

224-3177-5621.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat.

213-1519-2232.notablePrerequisites:
Myojin of Life's Web has at least two divinity counters on it.
You have at least one other nonartifact creature card in hand.
213-1519-2232.description:
Activate Myojin of Life's Web by removing a divinity counter from it, putting Gulping Scraptrap and another nonartifact creature from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gulping Scraptrap and the additional creature enter the battlefield, Bloom Hulk triggers once and Cloudstone Curio triggers twice.
Resolve the Gulping Scraptrap trigger, putting a divinity counter on Myojin of Life's Web.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Gulping Scraptrap and the additional creature to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2091-2239-2438-4558.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least nine tapped lands.
2091-2239-2438-4558.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Ardent Elementalist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Ardent Elementalist by paying its mana cost.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ardent Elementalist.
Repeat.

222-527-2438-5223.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-2438-5223.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

141-3645-5256.description:
Cast Black Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{B}
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Black Sun's Twilight.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Black Sun's Twilight
Resolve the Black Sun's Twilight copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1515-1850-4543.description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Rugged Highlands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping it.
Play Rugged Highlands, triggering it and Fastbond.
Resolve the Rugged Highlands trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Fastbond trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Repeat.

1296-2743-3280.description:
Cast Finale of Promise by paying {10}{R}{R}, causing you to cast Croaking Counterpart from your graveyard without paying its mana cost and copying it twice, with all spells targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Croaking Counterparts, creating three token copies of Biovisionary that are 1/1 Frogs.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

372-2705-2719.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
372-2705-2719.description:
Cast Sakashima of a Thousand Faces either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Sakashima of a Thousand Faces leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Suspension Field returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Suspension Field enters the battlefield, its triggers, exiling Sakashima of a Thousand Faces until Suspension Field leaves the battlefield.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Suspension Field until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Suspension Field leaves the battlefield, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces returns to the battlefield from exile as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

1420-2534-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Godsire does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Conspiracy.
1420-2534-4875.description:
Activate Godsire by tapping it, creating an 8/8 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Conspiracy, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Godsire.
Repeat.

647-2703-3518-5112.description:
Activate Mairsil using Myr Propagator's ability by paying {3} and tapping it.
Holding priority, activate Mairsil using Lion's Eye Diamond's ability by sacrificing Mairsil and discarding your hand, adding {3}.
Resolve the Mairsil ability from step 1, creating a token copy of it.
Repeat.

2034-4499-4749.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Somberwald Beastmaster.
Somberwald Beastmaster enters the battlefield, creating a 2/2 Wolf, 3/3 Beast and 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two of the tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

751-2440-4720.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Drake creatures.
751-2440-4720.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Mana Echoes ability, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Shrieking Drake's ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may activate Stonework Packbeast any number of times.

1202-4763-4955-5147.description:
Equip Myr Moonvessel with Grafted Wargear.
Sacrifice Myr Moonvessel to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage to any target.
Myr Moonvessel triggers, adding {C}.
Koll triggers, returning Myr Moonvessel to you hand.
Cast Myr Moonvessel.
Repeat.

797-1953-2105.description:
Cast Stolen Identity by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr creature token, then choosing to have all tokens you control become copies of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare one of the Combat Celebrant copy as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant copy triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.
